source_state: uncommitted bounded inference implementation with gather, dense embedding and floating softmax facts; exact gather axes and unsigned argmin metadata

native_runtime.patches: safemlx-sys/src/mlx-c/patches at the recorded source revision

command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test -p eredu-backend-mlx --lib --features metal,accelerate backend::nn::workspace -- --include-ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
measurement: Exclusive serial Metal test runner. Evaluate and retain inputs/parameters, synchronize to retire preparation temporaries, measure paid existing residency, then reset the MLX peak. Gather/embedding start a TokenValidationScope and evaluate output plus every retained validation array; synchronize before reading peak minus the existing baseline. Check validation result after settlement. Softmax likewise settles before each baseline and after output evaluation. Allocator cache remains populated.
inputs: Signed nonzero binary-fraction data exactly representable in F32/F16/BF16. Gather uses I32/U32/U8 indices, negative signed indices, invalid unsigned values, scalar/matrix/empty/4097-element index arrays, all three axes of a [3,5,7] source, and contiguous/stride-two inputs. Embeddings use [37,13] weights, I32/U32 scalar/vector/batch/empty/4097-token inputs, optional -7 sentinel and invalid IDs, with contiguous/stride-two inputs and parameters. Softmax tests both axes, precise and ordinary accumulation, contiguous/transposed inputs, empty rows, 4096/4097 kernel threshold and 32769-element general-axis reductions.

oracles.gather_and_embedding: exact host indexing of the original binary-fraction values; invalid indices select safe row zero pending validation; declared -7 sentinel outputs zero rows; validation must report exactly the injected invalid cases

softmax.implementation: independent f64 max subtraction, scalar exp, sum, and division for each selected axis

bound_derivation: Metal gather allocates only its output and reads source/index strides directly. The frontend transpose/squeeze aliases that result; no source-table copy or widening occurs.

Gather domain checks include two comparison input casts (up to I64 for U32 indices), scalar construction/conversion, four boolean intermediates and a retained any() reduction. Safe indices additionally include zeros_like and where buffers.

Dense embedding first normalizes IDs to I32, retains ge/lt/and/not/any validation, then repeats ge/lt/and and builds safe indices before gather. The quote includes every intermediate through completion.
Zero-sentinel embedding additionally includes validation eq/or, output sentinel comparison, zeros_like embeddings, final where and their scalar storage.
Final-axis floating softmax uses one result or one contiguous copy reused as the result. Precise accumulation stays in registers. Empty softmax returns the existing input.
General-axis floating softmax includes initial precision cast, max, subtraction, exp, sum, division, final conversion, both native reduction workspaces and possible contiguous copies.
All capacities include page rounding and bounded oversized cached-buffer acceptance. Existing source/parameter allocations are assigned separately; no donation or early release is assumed.
limitations: Full native attention, packed lookup/projection, preparation, materialization, collectives and separately retained resources still need bounds. These operator facts do not establish complete model quotes or production request-budget enforcement.
Integer softmax has axis-dependent native dtype conversion; its required output contract remains unpriced. Argmin metadata now records unsigned indices, but argmin workspace itself is still unpriced.
The covered domain is active tensor buffers; allocator-cache residency, Metal heaps, driver/JIT storage and unrelated process memory are excluded.
